profile_name: Aman Preet Singh - IT Support & AD Admin
summary: IT Support Specialist with 2+ years of experience supporting 250+ endpoints in a production environment. Experienced in Windows, hardware, software, network connectivity, user access, Active Directory, Windows Server, Group Policy, ServiceNow, PowerShell, and Azure. Strong in incident troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, technical documentation, escalation, and cross-functional support, with an enterprise Windows/Active Directory lab demonstrating endpoint administration, security controls, remote management, and ITSM workflows.

experience.title: On-site Desktop Support Specialist
bullets: Provided Tier 1—2 technical support for 250+ Windows endpoints, including warehouse workstations, shipping terminals, and office users in a production environment.
Diagnosed and resolved hardware, software, Windows, application, network connectivity, and user-access issues, minimizing operational downtime.
Administered Active Directory users, security groups, Organizational Units, and Group Policy to support user access, permissions, and endpoint administration.
Installed, configured, and troubleshot workstations, peripherals, warehouse technology, and business applications while supporting day-to-day operational requirements.
Investigated technical issues using structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, collaborating with cross-functional teams and escalating complex or high-impact issues when required.

Identified recurring technical issues and implemented preventive measures that contributed to a 15% reduction in repeat support requests; streamlined support processes contributing to a 20% reduction in ticket resolution time.
Documented troubleshooting procedures, technical solutions, and resolutions to improve knowledge sharing, consistency, and future incident resolution.
Provided technical support for scheduling and reporting applications, helping maintain reliable business operations and data accuracy.

projects.title: Enterprise Windows Server & Active Directory IT Infrastructure Lab
projects.technologies: Technologies: Windows Server 2022 • Active Directory • Windows 11 • Group Policy • PowerShell • ServiceNow • VMware • DNS • SMB/NTFS
bullets: Built an enterprise-style IT environment using Windows Server 2022, Active Directory, DNS, Windows 11, Group Policy, and VMware Workstation.
Implemented AD users, security groups, Organizational Units, GPO security baselines, Windows Defender Firewall, and role-based access controls.
Configured SMB file shares, NTFS permissions, mapped network drives and performed endpoint administration using PowerShell, WinRM, CIM, and gpresult.
Created PowerShell automation for employee provisioning and IT health telemetry; documented a realistic ServiceNow incident involving network-share access, investigation, remediation, and resolution.

education.details: Concentrations: IT Support • Data Analysis • Active Directory
